research.name: Zhejiang University, in collaboration with Dr. Jianghao Liu (Paris Brain Institute (ICM))
highlights: Research question: whether imagery signals in aphantasia fail to be generated, or are generated but fail to reach conscious access.
Design and methods: a near-threshold perceptual detection task paired with an imagery task, plus electrophysiological and neuromodulation measures of visual-cortical and prefrontal involvement.

Role: project lead, with Dr. Jianghao Liu as collaborator; built the experimental platform at Zhejiang University and was responsible for participant recruitment, data collection, and quality control.
